entries.claim: Arm 2 accepts a cold branch merely because its `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` path occurs anywhere in the router text; unlike arm 3, it does not exclude fenced blocks or require an actual prose Read.
entries.failure_scenario: Delete the prose Read for a registered cold file, while leaving (or adding) that same path in a fenced example/command block. `text.includes(...)` remains true, so `referenceRouterIssues` reports no `reference-router-branch-unread` issue and self-verify passes, although a reader following the router will never load the cold rule. This is especially plausible because the implementation explicitly recognizes fenced paths as subprocess arguments rather than router branches.
